requirements.text: Students complete a minimum of 60 upper division units, of which 35 upper division Simon Fraser University PSYC units with a minimum psychology cumulative grade point average (CGPA) and psychology upper division CGPA of 3.00 (calculated on Simon Fraser University PSYC courses only).

requirements.title: Check with an advisor
requirements.text: No more than six Research Engagement or Directed Studies units may be applied to this program.

requirements.title: Check with an advisor
requirements.text: No more than six PSYC Field School units may be applied to this program.

requirements.title: Check with an advisor
requirements.text: A minimum of 35 upper division psychology units must be completed at Simon Fraser University.

sections.title: Research Engagement Course

requirements.title: Check with an advisor
requirements.text: Courses listed without a rule we could read.

requirements.title: Check with an advisor
requirements.text: The minimum requirement is completion of the Tri-council ethics certificate, PSYC 201, 60 units, an upper division GPA of at least 2.5, and departmental permission.

sections.note:
Enrollment enables an individual to work with psychological research in consultation with the supervising instructor.
Research Engagement students complete an application form from the SFU Psychology website with the intended instructor.
This course can be repeated for additional credit with the same or different instructor.

requirements.title: Check with an advisor
requirements.text: The minimum requirement is an upper division GPA of at least 3.00, at least 60 units and department permission.

requirements.title: Check with an advisor
requirements.text: Each Directed Studies course must be with a different instructor.

sections.note:
Enrollment enables an individual or small group to work with a faculty member on a reading or research project of mutual interest.
Directed studies students complete an application form from the SFU Psychology website with the intended instructor.

sections.title: Douglas College Requirements

requirements.title: Check with an advisor
requirements.text: Students also complete the following at Douglas College which, upon successful completion, will transfer to Simon Fraser University as PSYC 4XX (15).

sections.note:
DACS 5111 Disability in Context (3) or DACS 3430 ASD Across the Lifespan (3)
DACS 5123 ABA Research and Applications (3)
DACS 5112 ASD Community of Practice I (1.5)
DACS 5113 ASD Community of Practice II (1.5)
DACS 5121 Applied Behavior Analysis: Basic Principles (3)
DACS 5122 ABA: Behavioral Techniques (3)

sections.title: Elective Courses
sections.note: In addition to the courses listed above, students should consult an academic advisor to plan the remaining required elective courses.
